records.text: An anonymous YouTube commenter said the object was a T-shirt collar and that its blackened appearance was more likely caused by burning.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep X3VKJVJ7cN4)

appearances.snippet: This piece is a collar from the T-shirt. The black would more than likely be from the burning of the explosion, but the thick folded and end that's facing the camera most surely the bias band, the seam of the T-shirt that looks clearly cut off.

verification.notes: Transcript context confirms Owens read an anonymous YouTube comment, but the commenter and pictured object cannot be authenticated from public evidence. Live searches found only the episode and no independent identification of the object.
